chunks: Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, created desire in ten parts: nine in men and one in women.

key_terms.إِنَّ: Indeed; a particle of emphasis introducing the statement
key_terms.الرِّجَالِ: Men; the male group mentioned in the distribution
key_terms.اللَّهَ: Allah, the divine creator mentioned in the report
key_terms.النِّسَاءِ: Women; the female group mentioned in the distribution

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the distribution of desire between men and women?
ai.summary: This hadith reports from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام that Allah, Mighty and Majestic, apportioned shahwah into ten parts, placing nine in men and one in women. The report presents desire as part of the divine creation and describes its distribution between men and women.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4620 - Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said:
"Indeed, Allah (swt), the Almighty and Glorious, created desire in ten parts, nine parts in men and one part in women."
